description: This file defines the UserRepository class responsible for accessing and managing user data in a MySQL database. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting user records, as well as various query-building functionalities specific to user data.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A repository class for managing user data interactions with a MySQL database, including querying, creation, update, and deletion of user records.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all users from the database.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: findBySubjectId
methods.description: Finds a user by their subject identifier.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds and returns a base SELECT SQL query builder configured for user data.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Finds an active user by username.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a user by their ID.

methods.name: deleteByIds
methods.description: Deletes multiple users by their IDs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: findByProjectId
methods.description: Finds users associated with a specific project.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates user data identified by user ID.
